description: This file defines an abstract class 'Shelf' that models a user's bookshelf in a book tracking application. It includes fields for the user and shelf name, along with constructors, equality/hashcode methods, and annotations for persistence and serialization.

classes.name: Shelf
classes.description: An abstract representation of a bookshelf entity tied to a user, with a shelf name.

methods.name: Shelf(String shelfName, User user)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the shelf with a name and a user.

methods.name: removeUser()
methods.description: Method to dissociate the shelf from its user.

methods.name: equals(Object o)
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare shelves based on user and shelfName.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to compute hash based on user and shelfName.
